GroupsItemResource._join_key (approx lines 274-302) returns master_secret and master_salt as a CBOR CoAP payload. Encrypted POST /groups in GroupsCollectionResource._create (lines 137-143) also returns master_secret on the same unauthenticated path.

spec/12-apps.md 18.8.2 Key Distribution: the join_key exchange MUST be OSCORE-protected with the pairwise context from EDHOC. Quote: Never sent in plaintext.

Any mesh peer who knows or guesses a group id can POST /groups/{id}/key and receive the current group OSCORE master secret. That is full compromise of group confidentiality.

new_value: join_key and encrypted POST /groups require a pairwise OSCORE identity bound after successful unprotect (oscore_context/oscore_context_id on request or remote). Spoofed CoAP OSCORE option, oscore_protected flag, empty identity, and group OSCORE contexts return RFC 7252 4.01 with no master_secret/master_salt and no membership mutation. OSCORE-bound join_key still returns spec 18.8.2 key material (32-byte secret, 8-byte salt, AES-CCM-16-64-128). pytest tests/coap/test_groups_{item,collection,rekey}.py passed.
